title: Swap: Swap text (daisyUI)
notes:
Swap allows you to toggle the visibility of two elements using a checkbox or a class name.

Needs daisyUI installed (npm i -D daisyui, then @plugin "daisyui" in your CSS).

Original file: https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui/blob/master/packages/docs/src/routes/(routes)/components/swap/+page.md
